Acitendravara
disciple of Advayāmṛta an. son of Rāmeśvara Dīkṣita. a. mentioned in ins.; see Corpus Inscrip. Telingana, Hyderabad Arch. Series 13, Vol. I., p. 10.

Acintyakramopadeśa
Bud. by Kuddālīpāda.
Cordier II. p. 213. JBORS. XXI. i. p. 30 (Aci. advaya. kra.).

Acintyaparibhāvanā
Bud. by Rāhula. Cordier II. p. 241.

Acintyaprabhāsa(bodhisattva)nirdeśasūtra
or nAmadharmaparyAya Bud. Sūtra. AMG. II. p. 235. AR. XX. p. 430. Kanjur Kyoto 771. Nanjio 396.

Acintyabuddhaviṣayanirdeśa
Bud. Sūtra. AMG. II. p. 217. AR. XX. p. 411. J.. 1927. Oct.Dec. p. 255. Nanjio 23 (35). 46.

Acintyamahāmudrā
Bud. by Tailikapāda. Cordier III. p. 108.

Acintya(rāja)sūtranāmamahāyānasūtra
Bud. Lalou p. 65. Same a. next ? [Page071-b]

Acintyarājā
Bud. AMG. II. p. 272. AR. XX. p. 468.

Acintyaviśvasāda
śaiva. Q. frequently in Śivāgrayogin's Śaivasaṁnyāsapaddhati.

Acintyastava
Bud. by Nāgārjuna. Cordier II. p. 6.
Text ptd. IHQ. VIII. p.. 689-693.

Ācciambā
mother of Śokkanātha, a. of Yudhiṣṭhiravijayavyākhyā.
